title: March 27, 2026
summary: A new AI Synthesis tab replaces the manual highlight board, auto-generating a structured summary (overview, key insights, major themes) once a study reaches 3 or more completed interviews. Major themes carry inline citation badges showing supporting verbatim quotes, linking straight to that moment in the transcript. Great Question also generates a highlight reel automatically, stitched from key quotes in your session recordings, with chapter cards. The legacy highlight board is still available under a 'Highlights' sub-tab. Improvements: unsaved-changes detection was added for eligibility rule edits; improved study duplication and sorting on the Repository table. Fixes: corrected the URL used for the Databricks integration.
body_markdown:
A new AI Synthesis tab replaces the manual highlight board, auto-generating a structured summary once a study reaches 3 or more completed interviews, an overview, key insights, and major themes. Major themes carry inline citation badges that show supporting verbatim quotes in your session recordings, with chapter cards so you can scrub to individual moments.


The legacy highlight board is still available under a "Highlights" sub-tab.
